name: Image Ticker Carousel – by Creavi
author: creavi

sections.description:
Elementor Image Ticker Carousel is a flexible and lightweight custom Elementor widget that lets you create a visually appealing, continuously scrolling ticker of images.

Use it to display logos, sponsors, featured items, or any set of images in a seamless horizontal loop. Designed to be easy to use with Elementor’s native drag-and-drop interface and tons of customization options.

Check out the live demo: https://wordpress.creavi.dk/ticker/
We’re open to any suggestions! Feel free to reach out via the support forum — we’re happy to hear your ideas and may implement them in future updates.

Key Features

  • Multiple Image Support
    Easily upload and add multiple images to the carousel with optional links for each image.

  • Customizable Scroll Speed
    Control the scroll speed in milliseconds to fit your site’s design and user experience.

  • Infinite Looping Option
    Enable or disable infinite looping for seamless, continuous scrolling.

  • Background Color Customization
    Choose a background color for each image to match your site’s theme.

  • Customizable Border Radius
    Apply rounded corners to images with adjustable border radius for a softer, more modern look.

  • Adjustable Image Dimensions
    Set custom width and height for images with flexible units (px, %, etc.), allowing full control over image sizes.

  • Spacing Between Images
    Adjust the spacing between images with a simple slider, ensuring a clean and organized layout.

  • Inner Padding for Images
    Control the inner padding (top, right, bottom, left) for each image to fine-tune the look and feel.

  • Scroll Direction Control
    Choose the scroll direction: left to right or right to left, based on your design preferences.

  • Pause on Hover
    Allow users to pause the carousel while hovering over an image, enhancing interactivity and user experience.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
  4. Drag the Image Ticker Scroll widget into any Elementor section and configure your images.
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor Free?

Yes! No Pro required.

Can I control the speed and direction?

Yes, both speed and direction are customizable via the widget settings.

Can I link images to external URLs?

Yes, each image can have an optional link with support for nofollow and open in new tab.

Is the ticker responsive?

Yes, the ticker is responsive and mobile-friendly by default.

Will the images loop infinitely?

Yes, if the “Enable Infinite Loop” switch is turned on in the widget settings.

Can I pause the scroll on hover?

Absolutely — there’s a toggle for that too.

Does this plugin work without Elementor?

No, this is an Elementor-only widget.

Can I use custom image sizes?

Yes! You can manually set image width and height in the widget settings.

1.0

  • Initial release. Features include image repeater, custom scroll speed, direction, spacing, image size, optional links, hover pause, looping, and full design controls.
